verdict.rationale: Sumsub supports WebSDK permalinks — a direct link applicants can use to complete verification without any code — which matches the 'no-code link' need, and dashboard-based manual approve/reject flows suggest an ops-friendly UI. However, there's no explicit evidence of a QR code generation feature or a dedicated no-code 'send verification' dashboard action described for one-off, ad-hoc use by non-engineering staff. missing for 10: explicit QR code generation, dedicated no-code UI flow for ops to trigger one-off verification without any setup, independent/hands-on confirmation.
